title: The Monte Carlo group at the top of the Knights of Malta, with Kissinger and Bush Sr.

tellings.quote: There's a thing called the Monte Carlo group that is at the top top of the entire nice of Malta structure.

plain: Dan Sheehan says a body he calls the Monte Carlo group sits "at the top top" of the Knights of Malta, a Catholic order of knights, and that Henry Kissinger and George Bush Senior belong to it. Sheehan tells Michels this as something he knows directly, in a conversation about UFOs and the killing of JFK; if true, it would point to a hidden circle of power above even well-known officials.
